items.title: Submit certificate of enrolment for winter semester 2026/27
items.quote: Please send us the certificate for the winter semester 2026/27 by 11 January 2027.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date by which the certificate must reach the insurer: 11 January 2027. No statutory delivery-fiction or period-counting rules apply since this is a private company's own stated deadline, not a period running from delivery. 11 January 2027 is a Monday, so no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed.

items.title: Policy switches from student rate to standard rate if certificate not received
items.quote: If it does not reach us by then, we will switch your policy to the standard rate from February 2027.
items.computation: The letter specifies that failure to meet the 11 January 2027 deadline results in an automatic rate change effective from February 2027; taking the stated effective date, the change takes effect on 1 February 2027 (first day of February 2027).
